summary: The intake try/catch quarantines a single createIssueWork RecordParseError as a safe record_parse_error skip, keeps valid neighbors, and the contract, sanitizer, and tests cover the reported incident path.

evidence: src/repair/loop-intake.ts wraps the createIssueWork call in a try/catch that recognizes RecordParseError, pushes a record_parse_error skipped issue with a ParseIssueCode reason, and continues instead of ending the run.

src/contracts/ports.ts and src/github/client-response.ts add and sanitize the record_parse_error skip variant with an allowlisted reason, so the reason survives into the intake diagnostic and hosted summary without raw source text.

tests/repair/loop-issue-source-context_test.ts proves one invalid issue is quarantined while valid neighbors persist, repeat polling does not duplicate work, an all-invalid listing stays idle with wire skips preserved, and unrelated exceptions still propagate.
tests/host/hosted-runtime-summary_test.ts proves the quarantined reason appears in the hosted summary, the run stays healthy, and the unsafe issue title does not leak.
